Something went wrong in this app
The report could not be prepared for a read-back. This is a problem on this phone, not with the patient\'s record. Trying again will not help. Tell your supervisor.
This can only read back what is written
You asked about a medicine or a condition in general. This can only put what the doctor wrote for this patient into simpler words. Ask about this prescription instead.
Ask about this visit
This only reads out what the doctor wrote for this patient. Try asking what the medicines are, how to take them, or what the doctor decided.
That is not on this prescription
You asked about a medicine or a dose that is not written on this visit. Ask about what is on the report above.
That cannot be answered from this record
Answering would have meant going beyond what the doctor wrote, so nothing was shown. Nothing is wrong with the patient\'s record. Ask about what is on the report above.
This phone is not connected
A read-back needs a connection. The report above is complete, and you can read it with the patient now. Try the read-back again when this phone is back on Wi-Fi or mobile data.
The connection is not secure
This phone could not make a safe connection. Do not try again. Read the report above with the patient, and tell your supervisor.
The read-back took too long
The connection was made but no answer came back in time. Try again now.
The read-back is not available right now
It is busy or not running at the moment. Wait a minute, then open this again. The report above is complete, and you can read it with the patient now.
The read-back could not be sent
This request was turned down and sending it again unchanged will not work. Read the report above with the patient, and tell your supervisor.
The read-back was not sent

Something written in this record or in your question uses symbols the AI would read as an instruction, so nothing was sent and nothing was changed. Read the report above with the patient, and tell your supervisor what was written.
The read-back did not work
Something went wrong while preparing it. Try once more. If it fails again, read the report above with the patient.
The read-back was cut short
The answer stopped before it was finished, so none of it was shown. Half an instruction is not safe to read to a patient. Ask a shorter question, or read the report above with the patient.
The read-back cannot be trusted right now
This phone could not confirm which AI answered, so nothing was shown. Do not try again. Read the report above with the patient, and tell your supervisor today.
